description: List available generation engines/models and their credit cost for a category. Call this before generating instead of hardcoding engine names. Returns [{ name, label, cost, paidOnly, supportsMultiView, supportsUltraMode, ultraCost, ... }] — use `name` as the engine/model value. NOTE: the two 3D surfaces are SEPARATE catalogs — `3d` is text-to-3D, `image-to-3d` is image-to-3D. An unrecognized category silently falls back to `3d`, so a guessed value returns a plausible list that is missing image-only engines.

category.description: `3d` lists TEXT-to-3D engines only. Engines whose vendor takes image input alone (e.g. meshy-7) have no text-to-3D row and appear ONLY under `image-to-3d` — use that before generate_3d_from_image.

name: list_models
